organic_growth.term_used: like-for-like; management cites 'organic top-line growth adjusted for the phasing related to the 2024 and 2025 IT transformation'

latest_interim.detail: LFL +6.9% and adjusted LFL +6.9%; scope +2.0%; FX -1.2%; constant FX +8.9%. Q3 2026 adjusted LFL +7.7%. 9M adjusted LFL by division: PPD +12.3%, CPD +4.2%, Luxe and LDB per release. 'Growth driven predominantly by mix and volume'. Travel Retail 'returned to positive growth in the third quarter'.

geography.largest_country: United States (named with China as 'our two largest countries'; % not disclosed)
geography.basis_note: Sales by region 2025 (EUR m): Europe 14,864.5 (33.7%), North America 11,718.1 (26.6%), North Asia 10,075.2 (22.9%), SAPMENA-SSA 4,114.3 (9.3%), Latin America 3,279.9 (7.4%); shares computed (INFERENCE from FACT). em_other_pct = North Asia + SAPMENA-SSA + LatAm (North Asia includes Japan/Korea and Travel Retail). Mainland China and Travel Retail shares are not disclosed in the release. 2025 LFL: Europe +4.4, NA +3.4, North Asia +0.5, SAPMENA-SSA +10.9, LatAm +8.3.

claim_checks.finding: 2023 like-for-like was +11.0%, not 7.6% (7.6% was REPORTED growth after -5.0% FX). 2021, 2022, 2024 confirmed. Added: 2019 +8.0%, 2020 -4.1%, 2025 +4.0% (record had 2025 LFL as 'not retrieved').

claim_checks.claim: Geographic split ~Europe 33%, NA 27%, North Asia 24%, SAPMENA-SSA 10%, LatAm 7% (2024, recalled)
claim_checks.finding: FY2025 actual: Europe 33.7%, North America 26.6%, North Asia 22.9%, SAPMENA-SSA 9.3%, Latin America 7.4%.

claim_checks.claim: China/travel-retail exposure and volume vs price
claim_checks.finding: China and Travel Retail shares are not quantified. FY2025: North Asia +0.5% LFL; 'Excluding Travel Retail, where the overall ecosystem remained challenging' growth improved from flat in H1 to +4% in H2, driven by mainland China accelerating from low to mid-single digits; US and China are the 'two largest countries'. 9M 2026: China the key driver of North Asia (Luxe China up low double digits), Travel Retail back to growth in Q3. Price/volume not quantified; 9M 2026 growth 'driven predominantly by mix and volume' (qualitative FACT).
